description: How Oxford Ledge's covered universe splits across sectors and industries (the whole catalog, NOT a portfolio). No arguments. Returns a BARE LIST of {sector, industry, tickerCount, totalMarketCap}, one row per sector+industry PAIR -- aggregate rows to get a sector total. totalMarketCap IS ALWAYS NULL: a count-only breakdown. Rows with a blank sector are excluded; a blank industry is null. Each industry sits under the ONE sector holding most of its tickers. Returns {error} (a dict) when the read fails. For a named portfolio use get_portfolio_positions. Source: Oxford Ledge company profiles, ~5,200 tickers.
name: get_sector_breakdown
title: Sector Breakdown
